content.text:
The persistence event path can overwrite fresh approval cards with their display-only snapshot, disabling valid inline approval controls. Existing tests do not cover this sequence with approval actions.

Review comment:

- [P1] Ignore widget-state echoes for live approval data — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-chatgpt-rehydrate/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:168-172
  When a fresh or preloaded approval result contains `resolve_lobu_approval` actions, this persistence call removes those actions before invoking `setWidgetState`; the resulting `openai:set_globals` event is then processed by `applyOpenAiGlobals`, which replaces the live view with the sanitized snapshot. The currently authorized card therefore immediately loses Approve/Reject rather than only becoming display-only after a reload; use snapshots only when no live output has been received, or ignore the setter's widget-state echo.
